section.content: 本发明之半导体集成电路包括：含MOS晶体管用于驱动负载的驱动器；及用于稳定因MOS晶体管栅―源寄生电容引起的MOS晶体管源极电压变化的稳定器。

The semiconductor integrated circuit of this invention includes: a driver including a MOS transistor for driving a load; and a stabilizer for stabilizing a change in a voltage at a source of the MOS transistor due to a gate-source parasitic capacitance of the MOS transistor.

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit)Technical field

The present invention relates to SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit), exactly, relate to the data output circuit that is operated in high speed.

Background technology

Be the processing moving data, require institute to reach existing high data transmission rate and further improve.Usually, in order to improve data transmission rate, adopted the technology of utilizing a plurality of data lines realization synchronous data transmission and under high speed, carrying out synchronous data transmission.In this art, a drive circuit requires to have each data line that connects with chip exterior.Because this drive circuit drives load capacitance, its current loss becomes bigger with the raising of transmission speed.If drive circuit is configured to receive electric energy from the power lead with the public use of other circuit, then this will cause insufficient power supply supply.This causes the decline of electrical source voltage and similar parameters, and causes the unstable operation of other circuit, and for addressing this problem, drive circuit is equipped with independent power vd DQ and VSSQ usually.

Yet when drive operation, the source potential that constitutes the MOS transistor of driver is done variation according to stray capacitance between MOS transistor grid and the source electrode.This has influenced the signal transfer rate of data conversely.

Figure 14 A is the circuit diagram of explanation prior art problem.Figure 14 B is the oscillogram of the analog result of Figure 14 A circuit working of showing that the present invention's inventor does.

Shown in Figure 14 A, the driver 5 of a corresponding data unit is made of P type MOS transistor 101 and n type MOS transistor 102.

Time t shown in Figure 14 B 1During this time, the input signal that enters driver 5 changes under the situation of low level (LOW) from high level (HIGH), changes to HIGH from the output signal of driver 5 from LOW.At this moment, shown in Figure 14 B during the time t1, because grid-source stray capacitance 112 that grid-source stray capacitance 111 that MOS transistor 101 produces and MOS transistor 102 produce causes source potential int.VDDQ and int.VSSQ to descend.

The power vd DQ and the VSSQ that voltage are provided for driver 5 supply with from other above-mentioned circuit separately.When each driver provided independent current source, the electric feeding capacity on the driver was little, and existence constitutes the transistor of driver 5 and do not have other element on the supply node of driver 5.Therefore, when having produced stray capacitance between the identical transistorized grid source at driver 5, the electromotive force at driver 5 transistor source node places is according to the variation transmission of driver 5 grid potentials.As a result, as the contact P of driver 5 lead-out terminals 1The time cycle that the place sets up electromotive force is compared with ideal state and has been delayed time t 2

Particularly, when driver 5 drove load under high frequency, the variation of source node electromotive force greatly influenced the work of driver 5.Source node is connected to power vd DQ or VSSQ through the bonding wire with inductance L, shown in Figure 14 A.Inductance L stops the electric charge supply and disengages source node.

Figure 15 is that the present invention's inventor does, when the electromotive force of the node A that is shown in Figure 14 A circuit when high (HIGH) changes to low (LOW), the curve map of the analog result of expression source node potential change.Say that definitely Figure 15 represents as node A electromotive force (A200, A400, A600, A800, A1000) change to 0V from 1.5V during, variation (P200, the P400 of resulting source node electromotive force when the time cycle changes between 200 psecs (PS) and 1 nanosecond (ns), P600, P800, P1000).

Curve P200 demonstrates, when at 200ps node A place signal when HIGH changes to LOW, the variation of source node electromotive force can not be limited constant voltage (1.5v) 10% within.Usually, transmission cycle [doubling the above-mentioned transmission time (for example from HIGH to LOW)] for the signal period 50% or still less.For example, represent under the part signal situation at curve P200 that it changes to LOW from HIGH and keeps LOW state 200PS with 200ps, change to HIGH with 200ps and keep HIGH state 200ps from LOW, the frequency of this signal is 1.25GHz.Suppose gate source voltage 1.5v, transistor thresholds voltage 0.5v, the drive current of 10% driver transistor will descend 30% if the source node electromotive force descends, and postpone the timing of turn-on transistor.Hundreds of psecs have exactly been postponed till setting up by the data of driver output.If have signal input Figure 14 A driver of 1.25GHz or higher frequency, it is bigger that the following general who has surrendered of source node electromotive force becomes.This has further improved the time that requires till being set up by the data value of driver output.

Therefore, from Figure 15 as seen, because above-mentioned delay is difficult to from the data of Figure 14 A circuit output 1GHz or higher frequency.

Summary of the invention

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of the present invention comprises: be used to drive the driver that load includes MOS transistor; With the stabilizator that is used to make the MOS transistor source voltage vary stable that causes because of MOS transistor grid-source stray capacitance, wherein, when the source potential of MOS transistor when first electromotive force changes to second electromotive force that is different from first electromotive force, because stabilizator is used the grid-source stray capacitance of MOS transistor and electric charge is fed forward to the source electrode of MOS transistor from logical circuit, stabilizator provides electric charge so that stablize the variation of MOS transistor source potential for the source electrode of MOS transistor.

In an embodiment of invention, driver drives load under 1GHz or higher frequency.

In the another embodiment of invention, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) also comprises the logical circuit that contains the signal MOS transistor that is useful on the reception of generation driver, and wherein stabilizator comprises the coupling mechanism that is used for driver MOS transistor source electrode and logical circuit MOS transistor source-coupled to the first power supply.

In the another embodiment of invention, first power supply comprises that an earthing power supply and electromotive force are higher than the power supply of earthing power supply electromotive force.

In the another embodiment of invention, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) also comprises logical circuit, wherein stabilizator comprises the node capacitor device that is used for coupled driver MOS transistor source electrode and logical circuit, and this node place electromotive force changes to the variation of driver MOS transistor grid potential conversely.

In the another embodiment of invention, capacitor comprises having the drain electrode that intercouples and the effect transistor of feeding of source electrode.

In the another embodiment of invention, driver also comprises the additional MOS transistor that is connected in series with MOS transistor, and this SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) also comprises an additional stability device, be used for stablizing because of adding the source voltage variation that should add MOS transistor that MOS transistor grid-source stray capacitance causes, wherein, this stabilizator comprises: first power supply and the second source that is different from first power supply, be coupled to first capacitor of the MOS transistor source electrode and first power supply, and be coupled to second capacitor of additional MOS transistor source electrode and second source; Wherein this additional stability device comprises: the 3rd power supply and be different from the 3rd power supply the 4th power supply and

Be coupled to the 3rd capacitor of source electrode the 3rd power supply of MOS transistor, be coupled to the source electrode of additional MOS transistor and the 4th capacitor of the 4th power supply.

In the another embodiment of invention, the first, second, third and the 4th capacitor all comprises having drain electrode and the effect transistor of feeding that intercouples of source electrode.

Therefore, here Shuo Ming invention makes provides the superior possibility that is generated as that comprises the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) that the respective electrical Source drive is housed, it can be stablized because of driving the change in voltage that the appearance grid potential changes the driver source electrode generation that causes, therefore can correctly transmit data under high speed.

Embodiment

The principle of the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) according to the present invention at first, is described.

When the driver of level after the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) is an output signal when the driver of chip exterior is controlled by the prime control circuit, result from back level actuator electrical and supply with the noise (change component) of node and had and offset, so that reduce the variation that electricity is supplied with node potential at the noise of preceding noise anti-phase.

Fig. 1 is the view of the explanation principle of the invention.

With reference to figure 1, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) 11 according to the present invention comprises the driver 5 that drives load 8, the control circuit 6 of Control Driver 5 and stabilizator 10.

Driver 5 receives from the signal of control circuit 6 and according to the signal that receives and drives load 8 by contact P1.Driver 5 comprises MOS transistor, and it produces between its grid and source electrode stray capacitance.

Driver 5MOS transistor source is connected to node 9 and accepts electric energy from power supply VQ and drives load 8.Power supply VQ can be earthing power supply or the electromotive force power supply higher than ground potential.

Node 9 is subjected to the influence of driver 5 change in voltage that cause because of the stray capacitance that produces between driver 5MOS transistor gate and source electrode.Yet stabilizator 10 is stablized the change in voltage that causes because of stray capacitance.Say that definitely stabilizator 10 is an electric charge from control circuit 6 received signals, and suppress because of the noise of grid-source stray capacitance based on the signal generation.In other words, stabilizator 10 carries out based on the feedforward control from the node 9 of control circuit 6 received signals.Say that more properly stabilizator 10 directly and/or indirectly makes the node 9 and the node of control circuit 6 be coupled, the node potential of this control circuit 6 is carried out inverse change with the potential change that produces driver 5MOS transistor source and grid.

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) 11 can comprise a plurality of stabilizators.For example, first stabilizator can be connected to earthing power supply, and second stabilizator can be coupled at a power supply that its electromotive force of terminal is higher than ground potential simultaneously.

The bonding wire of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) 11 through having inductance L is connected to power supply VQ.The bonding wire inductance L stops electric charge to supply with node 9 and therefrom release.It is especially remarkable when this drives load 8 under 1GHz or higher frequency.Yet according to the present invention, because stabilizator 10 is stable because of the change in voltage that aforementioned grid-the source stray capacitance causes, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) 11 can drive load 8 under 1GHz or higher frequency.
